related_questions.question: How many days are you contagious with COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: People with COVID-19 are typically contagious from 1-2 days before symptoms begin and up to 8-10 days after symptoms start. Contagiousness is often highest when symptoms are most severe, which is typically around day four of symptoms. However, this can vary based on individual factors like health and severity of illness.
